business_summary: A non-profit organization dedicated to ending the euthanasia of cats and dogs in shelters, seeking to acquire monthly recurring donors through checkout donation asks targeting pet owners.
product: Monthly recurring donations to support animal shelter efforts
stated_claims: Working to end the killing of dogs and cats in shelters.

relevant_tags.why: The advertiser specifically targets pet owners who care about shelter animal adoption.
Shoppers buying pet supplies are highly likely to be pet owners.
Shoppers purchasing pet food are pet owners, matching the primary target demographic.
The advertiser's goal is to sign up monthly recurring donors.

note_signals.why: A subscription-heavy pet brand whose owners are highly invested in their pets' health.
The largest pet audience in the catalog, offering maximum reach to pet owners.
The audience is explicitly noted for responding well to social-good messaging.
Millennial audience that treats dogs as family, aligning strongly with animal rescue and welfare.

gate_reason: The advertiser clearly outlines their goal (monthly donors), product (donations), and target demographic (pet owners/adoption advocates). This can easily be planned using pet-focused publishers.
missing_info: preferred checkout integration style (widget vs. post-purchase offer page)
clarifying_questions: What are the recommended monthly donation amounts you'd like to present to shoppers?
Is your organization a registered 501(c)(3) non-profit, making these donations tax-deductible?
Do you prefer a post-purchase redirect to your monthly donation sign-up page, or an in-cart donation add-on?
